scientific_question: On one frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B/H20 vLLM-Q16 request step, what paired end-to-end wall-time, CUDA peak-allocated, and audit-artifact-byte increments are introduced by enabling the existing live ForkAudit capture and ownership/receipt path?

model.attention_operator: vLLM 0.26 unified_attention over the frozen ForkAudit Q16 block pools

required_existing_components: Qwen35VllmPagedHitLedger as the capture-disabled mandatory functional adapter
MultiForkHitLedger with call_observer for the instrumented adapter
capture/verify persistent and request GDN binding guards
frozen_runtime_reuse.infeasibility_rule: If the two arms cannot be switched on the same frozen live runtime without changing the semantic model step, the experiment must report infeasible and must not substitute a toy path.

timing_population.pair_construction: Each pair rebuilds one persistent document and one two-request shared-reuse group outside the timed region. Both requests consume byte-identical frozen query tokens. Arm order alternates and physical request slot is preregistered; the odd pair count is reported rather than presented as perfectly slot-balanced.
timing_population.estimand_scope: one live request step from arm-specific adapter/instrumentation setup through synchronized model completion and, for the instrumented arm, completed live ownership/capture receipt persistence

baseline.label: capture-disabled
baseline.definition: Run the same Q16 request and unified attention through the existing Qwen35VllmPagedHitLedger with no append_observer, no call_observer, no source-content hashing, no KV/GDN ownership receipt, and no audit artifact write. Mandatory functional-adapter checks remain enabled because disabling them would create a different or unsafe runtime path.
baseline.audit_disabled_interpretation: The optional ForkAudit live capture/ownership/receipt layer is disabled; this is not a claim that all fail-closed functional adapter validation is removed.

instrumented.label: full-live-capture-receipt
instrumented.definition: Within the timed region, enable every full-layer append_observer, a MultiForkHitLedger call_observer, pre/post persistent KV content digests, live KV ownership checks, persistent GDN immutability guard, request GDN out-of-place-rebind guard, tensor sidecar writes, ledger verification, and an atomic pointer-free receipt.

common_timed_work: construct the arm-specific existing Q16 attention adapter/ledger
register the backend and switch the frozen backbone to that registered backend
execute one full-model 16-token request step over one already-built resident request
synchronize CUDA after the model step
verify that all ten full-attention layers used the fused operator exactly once
synchronize CUDA immediately before stopping the timer
instrumented_only_timed_work: hash persistent Q16 source pages before and after the request
capture and verify live KV ownership
capture and verify persistent/request GDN ownership and rebind receipts
enable append/call observers and synchronously copy/write fifty captured tensors
hash the closed capture binary and atomically write/hash the pointer-free receipt
timing_and_memory_protocol.baseline_excluded_work: The optional ForkAudit capture/ownership/receipt operations listed above are absent; no baseline audit artifact is created. Mandatory Q16 adapter safety/shape/operator checks remain common in spirit, using the existing lighter functional ledger.
timing_and_memory_protocol.peak_baseline_definition: Immediately before each arm timer, while that pair's persistent document and both resident requests remain live, run Python GC, empty only free CUDA cache blocks, synchronize CUDA, reset peak-memory statistics, then record memory_allocated and memory_reserved. Incremental peak is max_memory_allocated during the timed arm minus this recorded allocated-before value; absolute peak and before/after values are also retained. The first arm's completed request state remains live for the second arm, so order and slot are recorded and alternated rather than hidden.
timing_and_memory_protocol.artifact_bytes: For the instrumented arm, sum the closed binary capture and receipt files and record their SHA-256 values. Baseline audit-artifact bytes are exactly zero by arm definition.

validity_gates: exactly one discarded warmup pair and five completed measured pairs follow the frozen alternating schedule
each pair uses two distinct request objects over one shared immutable document arena and byte-identical frozen query tokens
both arms reach every one of the ten full-attention layers exactly once through the frozen vLLM unified_attention operator with no dense fallback and no materialized attention mask
baseline has no append observer, call observer, ownership receipt, or audit artifact

instrumented arm has ten unique append captures, ten call captures, fifty binary tensor records, valid KV and GDN ownership receipts, immutable persistent KV/GDN state, and hash-valid closed artifacts
baseline and instrumented full-vocabulary float32 logits are torch.equal and their generated token IDs are identical for every warmup and measured pair
all measured wall and allocator fields are finite non-negative values
independent replay verifies result, semantic sidecar, capture binaries, receipts, schedule, validity gates, and recomputed paired summaries

estimands.primary: median over five measured pairs of instrumented_wall_ms minus baseline_wall_ms
secondary: five raw paired wall-time deltas and ratios
five raw paired incremental-peak-allocated byte deltas and their median
instrumented audit artifact bytes per pair and their median
estimands.uncertainty: Report all five pairs plus median/min/max; do not claim statistical significance from n=5.
estimands.negative_result_policy: Retain and report instrumented slowdowns, speedups, memory increases, memory decreases, semantic mismatches, receipt failures, and incomplete attempts. A semantic/receipt failure invalidates the overhead estimand but is not silently removed; a negative or counterintuitive numeric delta remains a valid measured outcome when all validity gates pass.

resource_requirement.shared_state: model and PG19 assets are read-only; output, audit artifacts, and compiler caches are experiment-private

claim_boundary.established_only_if_valid: paired request-step overhead of this exact live ForkAudit capture/ownership/receipt configuration on one frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B vLLM-Q16 H20 stack and one frozen PG19/query input
not_established: throughput, QPS, serving capacity, or concurrency scaling
native vLLM-engine continuous batching or production server latency
cross-model, cross-runtime, cross-hardware, or cross-input generality
